title: Reply with JSON
summary: Flask: Reply with JSON. Add an author field.
introduction: jsonify turns data into a JSON response. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Reply with JSON

blocks.text: jsonify serialises both fields. Flask commonly sorts JSON object keys, which does not change their meaning.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: JSON field order is not meaningful; Flask may sort keys.
